longForm.overview:

Where 🌍 reads as world-coded generic energy and 🏳️ reads as flag-coded universal energy, the Sri Lanka flag captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate Sri Lankan-coded energy - a "Sri Lanka pride" tag or a "Sri Lanka-coded" reveal.

The flag cue borrows from national tradition and the modern Sri Lankan-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as Sri Lankan-coded rather than literal.

What separates the Sri Lanka flag from the rest of the flag family is the specific Sri Lanka register. The emoji is not saying 'flag in general' (🏳️) or 'rainbow-coded' (🏳️‍🌈). It is saying 'Sri Lanka,' which carries a specific national, cultural, and Sri Lankan-coded specificity.
